## Activity

Oakridge Primary Care recorded 40 captures during July 2021. This represents the total capture activity reported for the site and month. The activity record provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes.

## Image quality

Of the 40 captures, 3 were marked ungradable. The ungradable rate was 7.5 per cent of captures. This result should be monitored as part of routine site operations. The clinic lead has asked that recurring camera issues be logged with the service desk so they can be reviewed and followed up through the appropriate support process.

## Grading

Grading identified 7 referable results. The median lag from photograph capture to grading was 0 days. This indicates that the middle value for the reported grading interval was 0 days for the month. Activity, image quality and grading results should continue to be reviewed together to support oversight of the service at Oakridge Primary Care.
